answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with a sequential apprenticeship ladder. A new identity earns standing only by finishing a chain of distinct deliveries for unrelated real clients, each verified before the next unlocks, so the chain takes weeks of time no parallel copies can compress. A falcon flies each leg of a migration itself, and progress never transfers between identities. Each further identity on the same funding trail pays a doubled entry fee in outside money and must build its own bridge of fresh client ties, while a reef of escrow slashes the trail if one fake is caught.
